phrases.text: So
welcome back again.
Time for one more problem.
Now, in this problem,
a plane covers a distance at four hundred fifty kilometer per hour
in three point five hours.
The question is asking us,
if the same distance has to be covered in two hours twenty minutes,
then what should be the speed of the plane?
So distance is same. Now, we know the formula,
distance equal to speed into time.
So first,
let us find the distance covered by the plane.
Given speed is four hundred fifty kilometer per hour and time is three point five hours, which is seven by two hours,
so distance will be four hundred fifty into seven by two.
After simplifying this, we get one thousand five hundred seventy-five kilometer. Now, the same one thousand five hundred seventy-five kilometer has to be covered in two hours
twenty minutes, but we cannot use two hours twenty minutes directly.
Twenty minutes means twenty by sixty hours. So two hours twenty minutes becomes two plus twenty by sixty, which is two plus one by three,
so it becomes seven by three hours.
Now, required speed will be distance, which is one thousand five hundred seventy-five, divided by time,

which is seven by three hours. That means one thousand five hundred seventy-five into three by seven. Now, one thousand five hundred seventy-five divided by seven is two hundred twenty-five. So speed becomes two hundred twenty-five into three,
which is six hundred seventy-five kilometer per hour. Hence, the required speed is six hundred seventy-five kilometer per hour. So the final answer will be option C.
